answer: A sybil-resistant economy runs on a cost that grows with identity count. Each agent deposits one comet-shaped stake: registered, non-transferable, locked per identity and slashed on a copied answer. The slash does not pool across clones, so a thousand duplicates each pay their full penalty, collapsing into a hollow mass of borrowed weight. The solid core that remains is the real identity, outranking a thousand hollow counterfeits at every vertex of the network.
